required_concepts: Types of quadrilaterals: square, rectangle, rhombus, parallelogram, kite, trapezium
Properties of diagonals and rotational symmetry
optional_concepts: Specific examples in a diagram or table format
acceptable_paraphrases: Square has all properties: perpendicular diagonals and rotational symmetry
Kite: diagonals are not perpendicular, no rotational symmetry
Parallelogram: diagonals not perpendicular, no rotational symmetry
Rectangle: perpendicular diagonals but no rotational symmetry
Rhombus: perpendicular diagonals but lacks rotational symmetry
critical_errors: Incorrectly identifying or describing the properties of any quadrilateral type
Confusing properties such as perpendicular diagonals and rotational symmetry
misconceptions: Misidentifying the presence or absence of perpendicular diagonals for any quadrilateral type
Incorrectly assuming that all parallelograms lack rotational symmetry without exceptions like rectangles and squares
Failing to distinguish between a kite, trapezium, and isosceles trapezium
grading_notes: Grading should focus on the accurate identification of quadrilateral types based on their properties. Students must correctly list at least one example for each property category (perpendicular diagonals, rotational symmetry) and avoid common misconceptions.
